title: Dot Connect
keys: Arrow keys move. Enter on a dot starts a line; Enter again stops.

status.fill: {joined} of {total} pairs joined. {filled} of {open} squares filled.

prompt.join: Join each pair of matching letters.
prompt.fill: Join each pair and fill every square.
prompt.walls: Join each pair and fill every square. Go round the walls.
prompt.steps: Join each pair and fill every square. {letter} takes exactly {steps} steps.
prompt.bridge: Join each pair and fill every square. Lines go straight over the bridge.

refuse.dot: A line can only end on its own letter.
refuse.straight: On a bridge, a line goes straight over.
refuse.edge: There is no room on the other side of that bridge.

nudge.gaps: Every pair is joined, but some squares are still empty.

hint.kidTip: Find a dot with only one way out. Its first step is forced.
hint.gaps: Some squares are still empty. Stretch a line through them.
hint.forced: Dot {letter} has only one way to go.
hint.steps: {letter} must take exactly {steps} steps. Count the squares as you go.
hint.bridge: Use the bridge both ways: one line across and one line down.

solved.title: Solved!
solved.fill: Every pair is joined and every square is filled.

wrong.title: Nearly
wrong.gaps: Every pair is joined, but some squares are empty. Fill them too.
